title: Chaos Moon : 1CC Edition
description:
After years of watching Earth with envious eyes, the Martians have finally invaded and are launching their attack from their base on the dark side of the moon.

You are the Jetman, a cyborg with enough firepower to take on the alien threat.

Strap on your jetpack and set a course for the moon.

You'll need all your skills and dexterity to overcome the enemy and destroy the alien threat once and for all.

GAME FEATURES

• A game in the spirit of 80's and 90's arcade and console shoot-em-ups, created by fans of the genre.

• A single mission with plenty of extra objectives to boost scores and status.

• High-score Leaderboards to lay down the challenge to other players.

• Soundtrack by renowned musician Barry Leitch.

• Maximize your score on your run through, complete objectives, find the secret bonuses, and rescue stranded astronauts.

Hey pilot! Yes, you there!
Visit our website (over on the right) to play a free web demo!
description_short: A classic style SHMUP in the tradition of 80's and 90's vertical scrolling shooters. Maximize your run and get to the top of the High-score Leaderboard. Can you achieve the rank of Fleet Admiral? It's a challenge. Visit our website for a free playable browser demo of the game.
